identity.description: Otter.ai (Otter Voice Meeting Notes) is an AI meeting transcription and notes product. The claude.com connector page and the otter.ai title confirm the product.
identity.identity_notes: Product is Otter.ai, the AI meeting notes/transcription service. Page title at otter.ai/api/docs/ reads 'Otter Voice Meeting Notes - Otter.ai'. The MCP listing is 'Made by Otter.ai'. Help center article on MCP server is cited by search but was not fetchable (403).

auth.oauth_flows: MCP server (mcp.otter.ai/mcp) connects over OAuth via the user's Otter account, per Scalekit and the Claude connector 'Sign-in Required' label. Public API uses a static Bearer key generated in workspace Developer settings; Scalekit says it does not support OAuth.
auth.token_refresh: Not established for API key. MCP OAuth refresh behavior unknown.

access.production_restrictions: REST Public API is Enterprise-workspace only per Scalekit (third-party). Official MCP server requires Sign-in with an Otter account (OAuth); no developer key needed. Plan requirements for the MCP server are unverified; one third-party source claims all plans.

write_ops: POST to ingest a file into conversations (REST, per Scalekit)
api.rate_limits: 10 requests per second and two keys per user (per Scalekit, third-party; unverified against Otter docs)
api.limitations: Public REST API is Enterprise-only (per Scalekit). MCP server is read-only by design with three tools: search, fetch, get_user_info (per Scalekit and Claude connector). Recall.ai article states Otter has no official API, which is older and conflicts with later sources. Official API docs page at otter.ai/api/docs/ could not be read beyond its title.
